spotlight.heading: ## 🔍 Spotlight: Plugins vs. standalone skills vs. MCP servers
spotlight.body: SkillMaxx tracks three formats in one catalog: marketplace plugins, standalone Agent Skills (`SKILL.md` installed via `npx skills add`), and MCP servers (reference and npm). Plugins pack metadata and commands cleanly inside one agent's marketplace, while standalone skills and MCP servers aim to work across all five CLIs. See how each format is verified on [How we test](/how-we-test/).

evergreen_section.heading: ## 🛡️ Sandbox note: Why missing API keys are not bugs
evergreen_section.body: Our nightly containers start with an empty home folder and zero API keys or logins. Any SaaS MCP server or plugin that asks for a token at startup fails our keyless check and gets grouped under needs your key rather than broken. Open any listing from [today's report](/reports/latest/) to inspect the exact error line and required environment variable.
